diagram.title: Factorial of 3 calls down and returns up
diagram.caption: Push each call onto the stack. The base case returns 1, then each earlier frame pops as it finishes.

layers.label: 1. Push the frame for factorial of 3
2. Push the frame for factorial of 2
3. Push the base case for factorial of 1
4. Pop the frame for 1 and return 1
layers.detail: Send 1 back to the call for 2.

layers.label: 5. Pop the frame for 2 and return 2
layers.detail: Multiply 2 times 1 equals 2 and send 2 back to the call for 3.

layers.label: 6. Pop the frame for 3 and return 6
layers.detail: Multiply 3 times 2 equals 6 and return the final result.
